question.text: One mole of a symmetrical alkene on ozonolysis gives two moles of an aldehyde having a molecular mass of $44 \mathrm{u}$. The alkene is

solution.text:
2-butene is symmetrical alkene
$\mathrm{CH}_3-\mathrm{CH}=\mathrm{CH}-\mathrm{CH}_3 \frac{\mathrm{O}_3}{\mathrm{Zn} / \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}} 2 \cdot 2 \cdot \mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{CHO}$
Molar mass of $\mathrm{CH}_3 \mathrm{CHO}$ is $44 \mathrm{u}$.
